config.configuration_message:
Cornell University
Event Request Form
Submit your event details below — we'll take it from there.
 
Accessibility
If you have a disability and have trouble accessing information on this website or need materials in an alternate format, contact web-accessibility@cornell.edu for assistance.
 
Processing Time
Please allow up to 5 business days for the Scheduler to start processing this request. Reservation processing times vary depending on the activities and nature of the event. If you have questions about on-campus scheduling, please visit the Scheduling@Cornell website. Approved events are subject to all applicable university policies.
If your event includes any type of physical activity — sports, recreational activities (e.g., cornhole, ping pong, bounce houses, etc.), or dancing — all attendees are required to have a Waiver and Hold Harmless Agreement Form. Per Risk Management, 4 weeks are required for the University Events Team (UET) to review and approve the form.
Special Note for Expressive Activities: Requests related to expressive activities will be given expedited review and are subject to University Policy 4.23 (Interim Expressive Activity Policy). Approved outdoor camps must also comply with the Outdoor Camping rules and guidelines.
 
Planning Checklist
When planning an event, refer to the Accessible Meeting and Event Checklist to ensure it is accessible for all attendees.
Be mindful of your participants' physical abilities and limitations when navigating the physical activities of your event (e.g., tripping, slipping, falls, overexertion, allergies, weather conditions, etc.).
 
Fill In Your Details
Please fill in as many details as possible. Required indicates a required field.

item.item_message:
What's your event called? Give your event a clear, searchable name.

Ask yourself: what would someone type to find this event? Always lead with your club or department name.

Examples

“CCC Game Night”  ·  “Breakout Club Fall Kickoff Meeting”  ·  “Risely Latte & Learn Seminar”  ·  “Fashion Club Senior Showcase”

! Avoid these characters — they'll cause a save error: ! < > % ~ @ \ ^

item.item_display: What kind of event is this?
item.item_message:
What kind of event is this?

Pick the option that best matches what you're doing.

Options include

A meeting  ·  a social hangout  ·  a performance  ·  a workshop  ·  a game night  ·  a training  ·  or something else entirely

Don't overthink it — just choose the category that fits the vibe of your event.

item.item_display: What are the details of your event?
item.item_message:
What are the details of your event? Tell us everything!

The more you share up front, the faster your request gets processed — and the fewer follow-up emails you'll get.

Things to include

Who's coming  ·  expected attendance  ·  timeline & schedule

What's happening  ·  activities  ·  performances  ·  special setups

What you need  ·  tables, chairs, A/V, staging  ·  music, food, decorations  ·  layout ideas  ·  extra space

! Heads up — detailed info up front helps our university partners process your request more quickly and reduces back-and-forth.

item.item_display: Select the Student Organization/Department sponsoring this event?
item.item_message:
Select the Student Organization or Department sponsoring this event. Pick the main organization or department running this event.

This is the group that's officially responsible for the space and everything that happens in it.

Not a Cornell org?

If your group isn't officially part of Cornell, select the Cornell student organization, department, or office that's sponsoring your event — they're the ones agreeing to partner with you and help make it happen.

Can't find your org in the list? — Select “Organization Not Found in List” and you'll get a chance to type in the name later in the form.

item.item_display: How many people do you expect?
item.item_message:
How many people do you expect? Give us your best estimate of how many people might show up.

It doesn't have to be perfect — just a reasonable guess so we can assess space, setup, and safety needs.

Not sure? Consider…

Past turnout  ·  how many people your group usually attracts

Your promotion  ·  how widely you're advertising the event

RSVPs or sign-ups  ·  any early interest you've already seen

! Heads up — too low and there won't be enough room; too high and the space may feel empty or get reassigned. When in doubt, round up slightly.

item.item_display: What date and time is your event?
item.item_message:
Tell us the exact date and start/end time for your event.

This helps us reserve the right space and make sure everything's available when you need it.

Don't forget to include

Setup time  ·  arriving early to arrange furniture, AV, decorations, or food

Cleanup time  ·  time needed after the event to break down and clear the space

Multi-day events  ·  if your event runs across more than one day, note that in the details

! Heads up — the room won't be accessible outside your booked window. If you need time before or after the event, build it in now so you're not scrambling on the day.

item.item_display: Where do you want to host it?
item.item_message:
Where do you want to host it? Use the Location Search to find your space.

Look up by building name, room name, or room number — then hit Request to add it. Selecting a location submits a request, not a guaranteed booking.

Help us help you — book smart

One room only  ·  only request the space you actually need — multiple "just in case" requests slow approvals for everyone

Can't find it?  ·  uncheck Hide Conflicts and search again — still nothing? Select "Location Not Found in List" and enter the name later in the form

Ends in **?  ·  that space isn't fully scheduled in 25Live — availability may not be accurate, and a room scheduler will follow up with you

Open/closed hours matter  ·  a location's operating hours can affect whether it's available for your event time

Multiple spaces  ·  you can select more than one location, but only do this if your event genuinely needs more than one room

! Pro tip — after adding a location, click the star icon to save it to your Favorites for faster access next time.

item.item_display: Have extra details? Upload them here.
item.item_message:
Got supporting docs? Upload them here.

Uploads aren't required — only add something if it helps move your request forward.

Useful things to attach

Schedules or run-of-show  ·  so we know exactly how the event flows

Room layouts or diagrams  ·  show us how you'd like the space set up

Flyers or promotional materials  ·  give us a sense of the event's scope and audience

Up to 5 files  ·  max 25 MB each  ·  PDF, TXT, RTF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, DOC, DOCX, CSV, XLS, XLSX

! Heads up — do not upload files containing sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers, student ID numbers, or driver's license numbers.

What's happening at your event? Please answer the questions below as clearly as you can.

Your responses help our event reviewers understand what you're planning. Anything marked Required must be completed to move forward.

Need help?

Questions?  ·  email scheduling@cornell.edu

Policies & resources  ·  visit the Scheduling@Cornell website for full details on event activity policies

Safety & physical activities

Be mindful of your participants' physical abilities and limitations — tripping hazards, slipping, weather conditions, overexertion, allergies, and other risks.

If your event includes any physical activity — sports, recreation (cornhole, ping pong, pie-in-the-face, pumpkin carving, bounce houses/inflatables, etc.), or any form of dancing (lessons, competitive, or recreational) — all attendees must complete a Waiver and Hold Harmless Agreement.

! Heads up — the University Events Team (UET) needs at least 4 weeks to review and approve waiver forms, so plan ahead.

item.item_display: Event resources required to review and approve your request.
item.item_message:
Resources are auto-added based on your event activities.

If something appears below, it was automatically assigned based on what you selected earlier in the form.

! Heads up — some resource providers may need to review and approve your request before your event is officially confirmed.

item.item_display: I agree to be bound by the policies and procedures concerning the use of space and resources at Cornell University.
item.item_message:
By clicking "I agree," you're making it official.

The sponsoring student organization or department confirms all of the following:

You're confirming that your org or department

Completed this form honestly  ·  to the best of your knowledge

Will secure all required approvals  ·  it's on you to follow through

Will follow all building policies  ·  and procedures for the space

Accepts responsibility  ·  for any damages to University property or required clean-up

You're also agreeing to

Comply with all laws & policies  ·  federal, state, local, and University

University Code of Conduct  ·  your org attests it has read and understands it

Policy 4.8: Alcohol and Other Drugs  ·  your org attests it has read and understands it

Independent Organizations Agreements  ·  if your org is not part of Cornell, you are bound by these terms

! Heads up — if University staff are needed for repairs or extra clean-up after your event, the sponsoring organization or department will be billed.
